sense: one of the parts of a whole

terms.comment: The plain word for one part of a whole, whatever its shape: in partēs dīvidere, to divide into segments.

terms.gloss: a piece cut off; a strip, a zone
terms.comment: From secāre, to cut: properly a piece cut off, a slice (see slice). Pliny uses it of the zones into which the geographers divided the earth.

phrases.latin: plūra sunt haec segmenta mundī, quae nostrī circulōs appellāvēre, Graecī parallēlōs
phrases.english: there are several of these zones of the world, which our writers have called circles and the Greeks parallels

sources: Lewis & Short: pars · Lewis & Short: segmentum
